name: paradigm_238_alt_global_account_ls_ratio_extreme_bilateral_follow_4h_1d
hypothesis: global_account_ls_ratio (ALL-accounts aggregate) rolling 30d z-score extreme (|z|>=T) predicts near-term directional (FOLLOW or CONTRARIAN) alpha at 4h and 1d hold; 4-quadrant SNT bilateral.

item1_lesson_61_slug_grep.note: 'global_account_ls_ratio' as trigger slug not present verbatim in INDEX or RUNBOOK; runbook line 804 already lists this as an untested candidate (self-consistent). Prior LSR paradigms 16 (toptrader_account level z contrarian) and 233 (toptrader_position velocity z bilateral) used different columns.

item2_lesson_79_predictive_content_prete.method: OOS half of joblib intersection (SOLUSDT + BTCUSDT); compute corr(z, fwd_pct_change(hold)) full-sample.
item2_lesson_79_predictive_content_prete.conclusion: Max |corr| across all (sym x hold) < 0.02 threshold. Rule triggers R-0 HALT with verdict R0_HALT_LESSON_79_ZERO_PREDICTIVE_CONTENT.

item2b_extreme_subset_supplementary.note: Supplementary check on |z|>=T subsets (not part of formal pretest rule) to characterize signal quality after non-overlap enforcement. Naive t-stats on overlapping bars appear high (e.g., BTC thr=2.5 h=288 naive t=11.36) but collapse below 1.5 once non-overlapping event sampling is applied.
item2b_extreme_subset_supplementary.interpretation: After autocorrelation removal (non-overlapping entry cooldown = hold), ALL cells produce t < 1.5 and per-quarter sign flips. Naive overlapping-bar t-stats were pure autocorrelation inflation artifact. Even if formal Lesson #79 rule had marginally passed, Lesson #11 (sample density post-non-overlap) and Lesson #16 (concentration/per-quarter instability) would independently trigger R-1 fail.

item3_lesson_28_substrate_audit.coverage: 14/14 syms (ADA/AVAX/BCH/BNB/BTC/DOGE/ETH/FIL/LINK/LTC/NEAR/SOL/WIF/XRP) have global_account_ls_ratio column with 155k-255k nonnull 5m bars each

item4_lesson_62_dna_5dim.vs_paradigm_16_smart_money_lsr_contraria: 3/5 novel (substrate column DIFFERENT global vs toptrader_account; mechanism includes FOLLOW branch, not pure contrarian; statistic is log-ratio rolling z, same class)
item4_lesson_62_dna_5dim.vs_paradigm_233_toptrader_position_lsr_v: 3/5 novel (substrate column DIFFERENT global vs toptrader_position; statistic LEVEL z vs VELOCITY z; hold overlap 4h)

item5_lesson_56_outcome_family_proxy.note: LSR family: paradigm 16 BROAD_FALSIFIED and paradigm 233 BROAD_FALSIFIED. 2/2 prior instances of LSR-family trigger failed. This is 3rd LSR-family attempt with column swap; substrate is objectively distinct (aggregate ALL accounts vs toptrader subset) so Lesson #56 does not HARD FAIL but records the family precedent. Escape requires materially different signal characteristic — pretest shows it does not.

item6_lesson_39_axis.note: Direction axis = sign(ratio_z), not bar_direction. Genuine self-signaling per Lesson #77 escape criterion.

item7_lesson_11_sample_density.note: Naive bar-level trigger frequency at |z|>=2.0 ~5% -> ~1500 events/sym/2yr; but non-overlapping (entry cooldown = hold_bars=288 for 1d) collapses to ~26-71 events / 12mo OOS per sym. Below 30/quarter for majority of cells.

item8_lesson_40_structural_threshold.note: z distribution near-normal; thresholds 1.5/2.0/2.5 all feasible in both directions.

item9_life_changing_4dim_preestimate.note: Would have flagged util>100% at h=1d if trigger rate 5% + no cooldown; requires entry-cooldown design (already planned in item 2b analysis).

final_reason: Full-sample OOS corr(z, fwd_return) max |0.01527| < 0.02 rule threshold across 2 syms x 2 holds. Supplementary non-overlap subset analysis confirms t<1.5 and per-quarter sign flips at all extreme cells — signal is autocorrelation-inflated noise, not real alpha.
